title: Revenant : In Memory Of The Day
description:
"The child has disappeared."One day, a mother who lost her child desperately follows the traces left behind. During her search, she hears a rumor about a malevolent spirit that preys only on children and resides in the ruins deep within the forest. 

Clinging to the faintest hope, she tirelessly tracks down the place and finally arrives.

Just then, a familiar voice echoes from somewhere. 

Chasing the sound through the darkness, she soon finds herself trapped in an endless corridor with no way out.

There is only one way to escape.

Game rulesObserve your surroundings carefully and explore thoroughly to uncover any anomalies.

If you find no clues, move on to the next stage. But if you notice something strange, head for the exit.

They will try to deceive you by any means. Never let your guard down.

InputMovements : W, A, S, D

Walk : Left Shift

Flashlight : F

Interact : LMB

Uninteract : RMB

Rotation Reset : WMB
description_short: You are heading down an endless corridor in search of a missing child. Pay close attention to your surroundings to find clues about the child, and find a way to escape the dark, confined corridor.
